title: 嘉文四世·金甲天阶
description: 嘉文四世穿完整金蓝甲胄站在宽阶，长枪枪尾落地静持，蓝旗安静收拢，宫墙在远处化为简洁几何层次。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Jarvan IV is an adult Demacian prince with dark swept hair, a golden crown-like headpiece, strong eyebrows, and ornate dragon-inspired gold armor with deep blue cloth. Preserve his fully armored torso, covered legs, gauntlets, and boots with natural heroic adult proportions. His long lance rests upright with its butt grounded, and its blue banner stays gathered rather than raised for a charge.
art_direction.scene: Frame him on an immense stone stair landing, one hand resting around the vertical lance and the other at his side, gaze fixed on a distant horizon. The weapon remains separate from the body. Hard late sunlight emphasizes crown and armor edges in broad coarse wax marks, while long blue stair shadows and a single far tower create stately depth.
art_direction.palette: antique gold, royal blue, pale stone, copper light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
